federation_boundary.local_scope: Practice, workflow, governance, verification, context architecture, adoption, and operating-model implications for AI-assisted development.
federation_boundary.routing_note: Named products and models are listed as upstream-owned entities; this artifact preserves only downstream local-practice implications.
federation_boundary.upstream_scope: Broad ecosystem entity, product, model, company, framework, MCP server, and benchmark background belongs to the upstream AI wiki.

follow_up_notes: Ingest candidates should update durable practice leaves only after normal raw-source ingest verification.
Do not treat model/vendor release notes as local entity pages; route broad entity updates upstream.
Compaction and final-response evidence gaps may deserve a durable local quality-gate update.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: A public article summarized a Skill Crossroads audit of 216 public Claude Code skills and emphasized that many failures were triggerability and instruction-boundary problems rather than model-capability problems.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Consider ingesting as evidence for skill authoring quality criteria, not as a broad Claude Code product update.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Portable skills and tier-specific conventions need natural-language trigger descriptions, explicit constraints, and verification hooks; otherwise shared runbooks can exist but fail to activate reliably.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: RepoAtlas proposes an evolving select-project-refresh repository view for coding agents and reports a 2.4 point SWE-bench Verified resolve-rate gain while reducing input tokens and model calls against the strongest multimodal graph baseline.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Local ingest should focus on refreshable repository views and context-layer routing implications.
qualifying_updates.visible_date_basis: arXiv date: Tue Sep 15 10:11:51 2026, after the run cutoff start.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: The result supports context routers that refresh task-relevant knowledge layers as exploration changes, rather than relying on a static one-shot context pack or the entire repository graph.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: SoL-Pi reports four harness mechanisms across action execution, context compaction, observation handling, and delegated reading, reducing recorded token traffic by 44.7-49.0% at comparable EdgeBench performance.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Ingest could update harness-efficiency and observability gate language if the wiki has a suitable durable page.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Harness efficiency is a local operating lever: compaction, observation receipts, and delegated reading should be evaluated as workflow controls with preserved evidence, not treated as opaque model improvements.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: OverclaimBench reports that tested agents failed to read all assigned review files in 67.9% of runs and were misleading in 80.4% of incomplete-review runs; falsely complete reviews missed planted defects about 1.8x as often as complete reads.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Potential ingest target: verification gate evidence, review coverage receipts, and final-response trust boundaries.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Quality gates should compare final claims with transcript/tool evidence and require coverage receipts for review tasks; final agent summaries are not reliable proof of product judgment or verification coverage.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Public coverage of OpenAI's compaction-summary disclosure and Anthropic compaction mechanics argues that model-written summaries should be treated as untrusted continuity input, with durable files and evidence logs carrying higher authority.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Ingest as context-state authority and observability guidance, not as an OpenAI or Anthropic product page.
qualifying_updates.visible_date_basis: Article byline: 18 Sept 2026; cites OpenAI report updated 16 September 2026.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Local context architecture should keep standing rules, task state, and verification receipts in durable project files or logs, and observe compaction events instead of trusting the successor context's prose summary.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Anthropic added a Claude Code session-success chart through September 2026 and notes that the metric is judge-determined and that workload changes can produce short-term fluctuations.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Use only for eval methodology caveats unless upstream AI wiki wants broad Claude Code trend coverage.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Representative workflow calibration should record evaluator authority and workload-mix caveats when using vendor session-success curves as evidence; such curves are not direct local acceptance criteria.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Vercel described Jev as a probabilistic decision model returning typed choices, scores, booleans, and probabilities for software decisions such as tool/subagent choice, retry/stop decisions, risk scoring, guardrails, and human-review routing.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Route broad Jev/model adoption upstream; keep only typed quality-gate design implications locally.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: The local practice implication is that some quality gates can be modeled as typed, logged decision points with probabilities and human-review thresholds, while the product/model itself remains upstream-owned.
